description: Functions proven to be original assembler outside the main-executable PSY-Q provenance (configs/USA/psyq_provenance.json). Only these may use GAME_ASM_FUNCTION (origin game) or PSYQ_ASM_FUNCTION in an overlay (origin psyq). Each unit's yaml range must be exactly its listed functions. Policy: docs/ASM_AND_GTE_POLICY.md, 'Game-side assembler'; enforced by tools/scripts/check_source_policy.py. The separate stack_switch_macros list names the C functions that may use BOOT_CALL_ON_SCRATCHPAD_STACK (include/pe1/boot_stack.h), the only CPU asm allowed inside a C function; policy section 'Scratchpad stack switch'.

functions.name: Math_FixedMul
evidence: reads LO before HI and shifts both words in place (mflo v0; mfhi v1; srl v0; sll v1; or v0,v1,v0)
stock GCC 2.7.2 and 2.8.1 compile (long long)a * b >> 16 to mfhi before mflo and keep the dead high-word shift in the return delay slot (9 words, not 7)
no GCC-generated C form produces the 7-word retail sequence; the previous C used a three-instruction asm body for the whole multiply
functions.verified_by: agent review 2026-10-05: retail disassembly vs stock cc1 output

functions.name: Math_FixedRoundToInt
evidence: ori $at, $zero, 0x8000 followed by the trapping add $v0, $a0, $at: the assembler expansion of add $v0, $a0, 0x8000
GCC never allocates $at for C values and always emits addu for C addition

functions.name: Math_FixedRoundToByte
evidence: same $at constant load and trapping add as Math_FixedRoundToInt, with an 8-bit shift
GCC never allocates $at for C values and always emits addu for C addition

functions.name: Task_GpuPackPrimColor
evidence: non-leaf function without a stack frame: ra is copied to $v1 with or $v1, $zero, $ra and restored with or $ra, $zero, $v1
trapping sub $a1, $a1, $a0 in the jal delay slot and trapping add $v0, $v0, $a0 in the return delay slot
spimdisasm reports it as a handwritten function

functions.name: Math_SqrtApprox3
evidence: LO read before HI for all three products, with two NOPs before each following mult
the three bgez delay slots stay NOPs although the next mult could fill one
carry chain adds the carry before the high words (sltu; addu hi,carry,xhi; addu hi,hi,yhi); GCC adddi3 adds the high words first
stock GCC 2.7.2 and 2.8.1 compile the long long sum with an 8-byte stack spill, HI read first, filled delay slots and a dead high-word shift
functions.verified_by: agent review 2026-10-05: retail disassembly vs stock cc1 output

functions.name: func_8010C4CC

Psyz (PSY-Q 4.0) places DecDCTvlcSize at +4 of a 0x398-byte vlc object; the retail VLC object spans 0x8010C4C8..0x8010C860, also 0x398 bytes

stack_switch_macros.name: main
stack_switch_macros.window: 0x80012320..0x80012348: move $t0,$a1; sw $sp,0($t0); addiu $t0,$t0,-4; move $sp,$t0; jal func_8019234C; nop; addiu $sp,$sp,4; lw $sp,0($sp)
evidence: the retail code stores $sp at 0x1F8003FC, moves $sp to 0x1F8003F8 for the call to func_8019234C and reloads it afterwards; C cannot name or assign the stack pointer
the scratchpad address is loaded by compiler code into an allocatable register ($a1, lui/ori) and only then copied into the fixed $t0, so the address is a C operand and the asm starts at the copy
the rest of the function has an ordinary GCC frame (40 bytes, ra and s0..s4 saved) and matches from plain C
